traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

traits.name: Long-Limbed
traits.description: When you make a melee attack on your turn, your reach for it is 5 feet greater than normal.

traits.name: Powerful Build
traits.description: You count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift.

traits.name: Sneaky
traits.description: You are proficient in the Stealth skill.

traits.name: Surprise Attack
traits.description: If you surprise a creature and hit it with an attack on your first turn in combat, the attack deals an extra 2d6 damage to it. You can use this trait only once per combat.

traits.name: Duplicity
traits.description: You have proficiency in the Deception skill.

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.description: As an action, you can change your appearance and your voice to or from any Medium humanoid you have seen, or back to your true form. However, your clothing and other equipment aren't changed by this trait. You can remain in a new form until you use an action to revert to your true form or until you die. If you are damaged while in a new form, your true form is revealed.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: Accustomed to life underground, you have superior vision in dark and dim conditions. You can see in dim light within 120 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

traits.name: Gnome Cunning
traits.description: You have advantage on all Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws against magic.

traits.name: Stone Camouflage
traits.description: You have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide in rocky terrain.

traits.name: Svirfneblin Magic
traits.description: You have inherited the innate spellcasting ability of your ancestors. This ability allows you to cast nondetection on yourself at will, without needing a material component. You can also cast each of the following spells once with this ability: blindness/deafness, blur, and disguise self. You regain the ability to cast these spells with this ability when you finish a long rest. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: Thanks to your vampiric heritage, you have superior vision in dark and dim conditions. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

traits.name: Deathless Nature
traits.description: You have escaped death once; it is harder for death to find you again. You don't need to breathe, and you have advantage on death saving throws.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: You have a climbing speed equal to your walking speed. In addition, at 3rd level, you can move up, down, and across vertical surfaces and upside down along ceilings, while leaving your hands free.

traits.name: Vampiric Bite
traits.description: Your fanged bite is a natural weapon, which you can use to make unarmed strikes. If you hit with it, you deal piercing damage equal to 1d4 + your Strength modifier, instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike. When you damage a creature with your bite and that creature has a humanoid shape, you can regain hit points equal to the piercing damage dealt.

races.name: Dragonborn

traits.name: Draconic Ancestry
traits.description: You have draconic ancestry. Choose one type of dragon from the Draconic Ancestry table. Your breath weapon and damage resistance are determined by the dragon type, as shown in the table.

traits.name: Breath Weapon
traits.description:
You can use your action to exhale destructive energy. Your draconic ancestry determines the size, shape, and damage type of the exhalation.
When you use your breath weapon, each creature in the area of the exhalation must make a saving throw, the type of which is determined by your draconic ancestry. The DC for this saving throw equals 8 + your Constitution modifier + your proficiency bonus. A creature takes 2d6 damage on a failed save, and half as much damage on a successful one. The damage increases to 3d6 at 6th level, 4d6 at 11th level, and 5d6 at 16th level.
After you use your breath weapon, you cannot use it again until you complete a short or long rest.

traits.name: Damage Resistance
traits.description: You have resistance to the damage type associated with your draconic ancestry.

races.languageDesc: You can speak, read, and write Common and Draconic. Draconic is thought to be one of the oldest languages and is often used in the study of magic. The language sounds harsh to most other creatures and includes numerous hard consonants and sibilants.

traits.name: Chromatic Breath Weapon
traits.description: You gain a second breath weapon. When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can replace one of your attacks with a 15-foot cone of elemental energy. Each creature in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 + your Constitution modifier + your proficiency bonus). On a failed save, a creature takes 2d6 damage of the type associated with your draconic ancestry. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage. This damage increases by 1d6 when you reach 6th level (3d6), 11th level (4d6), and 16th level (5d6). You can use this breath weapon a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

traits.name: Psionic Mind
traits.description: You can send telepathic messages to any creature you can see within 30 feet of you. You don't need to share a language with the creature for it to understand your telepathy, but the creature must be able to understand at least one language or be telepathic itself.

traits.name: Gem Flight
traits.description: When you reach 5th level, you can use a bonus action to manifest spectral wings from your back for 1 minute. While the wings are present, you have a flying speed equal to your walking speed. Your wings look like shimmering, translucent versions of your draconic ancestry's wings. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

This damage increases by 1d6 when you reach 6th level (3d6), 11th level (4d6), and 16th level (5d6). races.name: Dwarf

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You have superior vision in dark and dim conditions. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You cannot discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

traits.name: Dwarven Resilience
traits.description: You have advantage on saving throws against poison, and you have resistance against poison damage.

traits.name: Stonecunning
traits.description: Whenever you make an Intelligence (History) check related to the origin of stonework, you are considered proficient in the History skill and add double your proficiency bonus to the check, instead of your normal proficiency bonus.

traits.name: Dwarven Combat Training
traits.description: You have proficiency with the battleaxe, handaxe, light hammer, and warhammer.

traits.name: Tool Proficiency
traits.description: You gain proficiency with the artisan's tools of your choice: smith's tools, brewer's supplies, or mason's tools.

races.languageDesc: You can speak, read, and write Common and Dwarvish. Dwarvish is full of hard consonants and guttural sounds, and those characteristics spill over into whatever other language a dwarf might speak.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: Accustomed to twilit forests and the night sky, you have superior vision in dark and dim conditions. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.description: You have proficiency in the Perception skill.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.description: You have advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put you to sleep.

traits.name: Trance
traits.description: Elves don't need to sleep. Instead, they meditate deeply, remaining semiconscious, for 4 hours a day. The word for this meditation is "trance", a word borrowed from the human language. While meditating in this way, you can dream after a fashion; such dreams are actually mental exercises that have become reflexive through years of practice. After resting in this way, you gain the same benefit that a human does from 8 hours of sleep.

traits.name: Eladrin Season
traits.description: When you finish a long rest, you can change your season. You can also change your season as a bonus action on your turn. Your season determines your Fey Step effect.

traits.name: Fey Step
traits.description:
You can cast the misty step spell once using this trait. You regain the ability to do so when you finish a short or long rest. When you use Fey Step, your season determines the effect:
- **Autumn**: When you teleport, up to two creatures of your choice that you can see within 10 feet of you must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (DC 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier) or be charmed by you for 1 minute, or until you or your allies damage them.
- **Winter**: When you teleport, one creature of your choice that you can see within 5 feet of the space you left must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (DC 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier) or be frightened of you until the end of your next turn.
- **Spring**: When you teleport, you can touch one willing creature within 5 feet of you. That creature then teleports to an unoccupied space of your choice that you can see within 5 feet of your destination.
- **Summer**: When you teleport, each creature of your choice that you can see within 5 feet of you takes fire damage equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of 1).

choices.name: Eladrin Season
choices.description: Choose your season. This determines the effect of your Fey Step ability.

options.name: Autumn
options.description: When you teleport, up to two creatures of your choice that you can see within 10 feet of you must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by you for 1 minute.

options.name: Winter
options.description: When you teleport, one creature of your choice that you can see within 5 feet of the space you left must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of you until the end of your next turn.

options.name: Spring
options.description: When you teleport, you can touch one willing creature within 5 feet of you. That creature then teleports to an unoccupied space of your choice that you can see within 5 feet of your destination.

options.name: Summer
options.description: When you teleport, each creature of your choice that you can see within 5 feet of you takes fire damage equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of 1).

While meditating, you can dream after a fashion; such dreams are actually mental exercises that have become reflexive through years of practice. After resting this way, you gain the same benefit that a human does from 8 hours of sleep.

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.description: You have proficiency in the Perception skill.

races.languageDesc: You can speak, read, and write Common and Elvish. Elvish is fluid, with subtle intonations and intricate grammar. Elven literature is rich and varied, and their songs and poems are famous among other races. Many bards learn their language so they can add Elvish ballads to their repertoires.

traits.name: Firbolg Magic
traits.description: You can cast the detect magic and disguise self spells with this trait. When you use this version of disguise self, you can seem to be a humanoid of normal size. When you cast either spell with this trait, you can cast it again with this trait when you finish a long rest. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

traits.name: Hidden Step
traits.description: As a bonus action, you can magically turn invisible until the start of your next turn or until you attack, deal damage, or force someone to make a saving throw. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

traits.name: Powerful Build
traits.description: You count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift.

traits.name: Speech of Beast and Leaf
traits.description: You have the ability to communicate in a limited manner with beasts and plants. They can understand the meaning of your words, though you have no special ability to understand them in return. You have advantage on all Charisma checks you make to influence them.

traits.name: Decadent Mastery
traits.description: You learn one language of your choice, and you gain proficiency with one skill or tool of your choice. In the timeless city of Tu'narath, githyanki have honed psionic disciplines for eons.

traits.name: Psychic Resilience
traits.description: You have resistance to psychic damage.

traits.name: Githyanki Psionics
traits.description: You know the mage hand cantrip, and the hand is invisible when you cast it with this trait. When you reach 3rd level, you can cast the jump spell once with this trait, and you regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest. When you reach 5th level, you can cast the misty step spell once with this trait, and you regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for these spells. When you cast them with this trait, you don't need components.

choices.name: Decadent Mastery: Language
choices.description: Learn one language of your choice.

choices.name: Decadent Mastery: Skill or Tool
choices.description: Gain proficiency with one skill or tool of your choice.

traits.name: Mental Discipline
traits.description: You have advantage on saving throws against the charmed and frightened conditions.

traits.name: Psychic Resilience
traits.description: You have resistance to psychic damage.

traits.name: Githzerai Psionics
traits.description: You know the mage hand cantrip, and the hand is invisible when you cast it with this trait. When you reach 3rd level, you can cast the shield spell once with this trait, and you regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest. When you reach 5th level, you can cast the detect thoughts spell once with this trait, and you regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for these spells. When you cast them with this trait, you don't need components.

traits.name: Nimble Escape
traits.description: You can take the Disengage or Hide action as a bonus action on each of your turns.

races.name: Half-Orc

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You have superior vision in dark and dim conditions. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You cannot discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

traits.name: Savage Attacks
traits.description: When you score a critical hit with a melee weapon attack, you can roll one of the weapon's damage dice one additional time and add it to the extra damage of the critical hit.

traits.name: Relentless Endurance
traits.description: When you are reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 hit point instead. you cannot use this feature again until you finish a long rest.

traits.name: Menacing
traits.description: You gain proficiency in the Intimidation skill.

races.languageDesc: You can speak, read, and write Common and Orc. Orc is a harsh, grating language with hard consonants. It has no script of its own but is written in the Dwarvish script.

races.name: Halfling

traits.name: Brave
traits.description: You have advantage on saving throw against being frightened.

traits.name: Halfling Nimbleness
traits.description: You can move through the space of any creature that is of a size larger than yours.

traits.name: Lucky
traits.description: When you roll a 1 on the d20 for an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll.

races.languageDesc: You can speak, read, and write Common and Halfling. The Halfling language isn't secret, but halflings are loath to share it with others. They write very little, so they don't have a rich body of literature. Their oral tradition, however, is very strong. Almost all halflings speak Common to converse with the people in whose lands they dwell or through which they are traveling.

traits.name: Fey
traits.description: Your creature type is Fey, rather than Humanoid.

traits.name: Hex Magic
traits.description: You can cast the hex spell with this trait. Starting at 3rd level, you can also cast the blindness/deafness spell with this trait. Starting at 5th level, you can also cast the ray of enfeeblement spell with this trait. Once you cast any of these spells with this trait, you can't cast that spell with it again until you finish a long rest. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

traits.name: Eerie Token
traits.description: As a bonus action, you can remove a lock of hair, one of your teeth, or some other part of your body and incorporate it into a token. If your token is destroyed, you take 1d6 psychic damage. You can use the token as a spellcasting focus for your spells, and you can use the token to cast the sending spell without expending a spell slot. Once you cast sending in this way, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

traits.name: Martial Training
traits.description: You are proficient with two martial weapons of your choice.

traits.name: Saving Face
traits.description: Whenever you make an ability check and miss by 4 or less, you can treat the roll as if you had missed by 5. If you do so, you gain a luck point. You can spend a luck point when you make an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw to roll an additional d6 and add it to your roll. You regain all luck points when you finish a long rest.

races.name: Human

traits.name: Versatile
traits.description: Humans are the most adaptable and ambitious people among the common races. They have a drive to achieve and a capacity for innovation, making them excellent at a wide variety of roles.

races.languageDesc: You can speak, read, and write Common and one extra language of your choice. Humans typically learn the languages of other peoples they deal with, including obscure dialects. They are fond of sprinkling their speech with words borrowed from other tongues: Orc curses, Elvish musical expressions, Dwarvish military phrases, and so on.

traits.name: Expert Forgery
traits.description: You can duplicate other creatures' handwriting and craftwork. You have advantage on all checks made to produce forgeries or duplicates of existing objects.

traits.name: Kenku Training
traits.description: You are proficient in your choice of two of the following skills: Acrobatics, Deception, Stealth, and Sleight of Hand.

traits.name: Mimicry
traits.description: You can mimic sounds you have heard, including voices. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful Wisdom (Insight) check opposed by your Charisma (Deception) check.

traits.name: Bite
traits.description: Your fanged maw is a natural weapon, which you can use to make unarmed strikes. If you hit, you deal piercing damage equal to 1d6 + your Strength modifier, instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike.

traits.name: Cunning Artisan
traits.description: As part of a short rest, you can harvest bone and hide from a slain beast, construct, dragon, monstrosity, or plant creature of size Small or larger to create one of the following items: a shield, a club, a javelin, or 4d4 pieces of ammunition. To use this trait, you need a blade, such as a dagger, or appropriate artisan's tools, such as leatherworker's tools.

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.description: You can hold your breath for 15 minutes at a time.

traits.name: Natural Armor
traits.description: When you aren't wearing armor, your AC is 13 + your Dexterity modifier. You can use a shield and still gain this benefit.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

traits.name: Menacing
traits.description: You are proficient in the Intimidation skill.

traits.name: Powerful Build
traits.description: You count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift.

traits.name: Relentless Endurance
traits.description: When you are reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 hit point instead. You can't use this feature again until you finish a long rest.

traits.name: Deathless Nature
traits.description: You have escaped death once; it is harder for death to find you again. You have advantage on death saving throws, and you don't need to eat, drink, or breathe.

traits.name: Knowledge from a Past Life
traits.description: You have fragments of memories from a past life. When you make an ability check that uses a skill, you can roll a d6 and add it to your roll. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

traits.name: Reborn Resilience
traits.description: Your body is partially spectral, granting you resistance to necrotic damage. In addition, you have advantage on saving throws against disease and poison.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.description: You are proficient in the Perception skill.

traits.name: Shifting
traits.description: As a bonus action, you can assume a more bestial appearance. This transformation lasts for 1 minute, until you die, or until you revert to your bonus action. When you shift, you gain temporary hit points equal to your level + your Constitution modifier (minimum of 1 temporary hit point). You also gain additional benefits that depend on one of the following shifter options you choose: Beasthide, Longtooth, Swiftstride, or Wildhunt. Once you shift, you can't do so again until you finish a short or long rest.

choices.name: Shifter Type
choices.description: Choose your shifter type. This determines the additional benefit you gain when you shift.

options.name: Beasthide
options.description: While shifted, you have a +1 bonus to AC.

options.name: Longtooth
options.description: While shifted, your fanged maw is a natural weapon, which you can use to make unarmed strikes. If you hit, you deal piercing damage equal to 1d6 + your Strength modifier.

options.name: Swiftstride
options.description: While shifted, your walking speed increases by 10 feet.

options.name: Wildhunt
options.description: While shifted, you have advantage on Wisdom checks.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

traits.name: Feline Agility
traits.description: Your reflexes and agility allow you to move with a burst of speed. When you move on your turn in combat, you can double your speed until the end of the turn. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you move 0 feet on one or more of your turns.

traits.name: Cat's Claws
traits.description: Because of your retractable claws, you have a climbing speed of 20 feet. In addition, your claws are natural weapons, which you can use to make unarmed strikes. If you hit, you deal slashing damage equal to 1d4 + your Strength modifier, instead of the normal damage for an unarmed strike.

traits.name: Cat's Talent
traits.description: You have proficiency in the Perception and Stealth skills.

races.name: Tiefling

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You have superior vision in dark and dim conditions. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You cannot discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

traits.name: Hellish Resistance
traits.description: You have resistance to fire damage.

traits.name: Infernal Legacy
traits.description: You know the thaumaturgy cantrip. When you reach 3rd level, you can cast the hellish rebuke spell as a 2nd-level spell once with this trait and regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest. When you reach 5th level, you can cast the darkness spell once with this trait and regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

races.languageDesc: You can speak, read, and write Common and Infernal.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: You can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Control Air and Water
traits.description: A child of the sea, you can call on the magic of elemental air and water. You can cast the fog cloud spell with this trait. Starting at 3rd level, you can cast the gust of wind spell with this trait. Starting at 5th level, you can cast the water walk spell with this trait. Once you cast any of these spells with this trait, you can't cast that spell with it again until you finish a long rest. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for them.

traits.name: Emissary of the Sea
traits.description: Aquatic beasts have an instinctive understanding of your telepathic utterances. You have advantage on all Charisma checks you make to influence beasts that can breathe water.

traits.name: Guardians of the Depths
traits.description: Adapted to even the most extreme ocean depths, you have resistance to cold damage.
